definition: authoring what surrounds me, because only what I can see comes to mind

settled:
What surrounds me is my memory and my agenda. What is in it can come to mind and what is not cannot.

Out of sight mostly stops existing. There is no quiet backlog for a dropped intention to return from.

So I take cues out to quiet a want: no visible clocks, and very little in the room. The clocks are one case of a rule I took whole, that hurry is removed at its source rather than managed once it has arrived.

And I put cues in to fire one: the weight set moved into my office bought forty workouts in two months. Outside the office the intention had to come back on its own, which is the broken step. Inside it, the sight of them makes the intention again every time.

I keep the scattering cues out, social media above all. Something that fires me in ten directions authors my attention for me. The point is not only choosing what gets in. It is denying entry.

title: Building My Wants Into The Room
